================================================================================
Short regex spelling after operand reduction
================================================================================
if (value) is# other
---
(program (comparison (operand (word)) (word)))

================================================================================
Longer regex spelling after operand reduction
================================================================================
if (value) isb# other
---
(program (comparison (operand (word)) (word)))

================================================================================
Immediate identifier operand followed by reduction
================================================================================
if a:value is# other
---
(program (comparison (operand (immediate_identifier)) (word)))

================================================================================
No continuation-only follower
================================================================================
if (value) is other
---
(program (comparison (operand (word)) (word)))

================================================================================
Regex keyword prefix stays inside a whole word outside comparison
================================================================================
isb#name
---
(program (word))

================================================================================
Missing right operand is rejected
:error
================================================================================
if (value) isb#
---
(program (comparison (operand (word)) (MISSING word)))

================================================================================
Unknown comparison keyword is rejected
:error
================================================================================
if (value) other name
---
(program (ERROR (operand (word)) (word)) (word))
